ios.desc:
Festiveo is your guide to the world’s biggest music festivals. Discover music festivals around the world, see where your favorite artists perform, explore line-ups, schedules, set times, get artist announcements, plan who you want to see, and sync your plans with friends — all in one smooth, easy app.

Key Features:

■ Match your fav artists to thousands of festival & rave lineups
Choose your artists and immediately see festivals where they perform sorted by best match. 
Find perfect festival where most of your artists perform.

■ Integrations with music services
Get better recommendations by syncing with Apple Music, Spotify, YouTube Music, Deezer or Last.fm.

■ Explore festivals nearby
Explore festivals nearby or in selected distance range (up to 1000 miles)
Use smart search options to filter festivals by your genres, continents and countries.

■ Notifications
Get notifications when found festivals nearby, when your favorite artists attends new festival.
Track festivals you want to go to and get notified on lineup or schedule updates.
Get notified on early bird ticket updates for festivals you have already attended last year!
Tracking changes on thousands of festivals now become much easier!

■ Explore line-ups & schedules
Check festival line-ups, daily schedules, stage times — updated as soon as organizers announce changes. 
Get notifications on every important festival update. 
Discover lineup rumors and make predictions while waiting for line-up announcement.

■ Build your personal festival plan
Mark festivals you want to attend.
Add festival widget to your Home Screen and Apple Watch.
Track festival countdown at glance.

■ Build your own festival schedule choosing your best artists from different stages.
Create your own schedule so you never miss a gig. 
Mark your favorite artists and see exactly where and when they’re performing. 
Essential for multi-day and multi-stage festivals!

■ Apple Widgets, Apple Watch support, iPad support
Stay in touch with your festival plan whenever you are.
Choose widget color scheme you prefer (from vibrant to dark). 

■ Connect with friends & like-minded fans
Share your plans and find friends attending the same festivals or loving similar artists.
Add friend and follow their festival plans.
Track shared artists.

■ Tickets & essentials
Access official ticket info and useful details to stay organized and stress-free.

■ Stay in sync
Track upcoming events, get updates, and share your festival journey with others.

show_hn.title: Show HN: I built a festival tracker that matches lineups to your music library

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I built this app because I was tired of manually checking festival lineups against my music library every summer. I wanted a way to instantly see which festivals had the highest 'match' density for my specific taste.

Why I built this:

I missed one of my favorite artists at a festival last year simply because I didn't recognize their name on a crowded poster. I realized that with Apple Music/Spotify APIs, this discovery process should be automated.

Key Features:

Library Matching:
It scans your library and ranks upcoming festivals by how many artists you actually follow.

Apple Sync: 
Seamlessly imports your top artists and creates custom schedules.

Offline-First:
Since festival cell service is notoriously terrible, I focused on a robust local caching system so your schedule and maps work without a signal.

Technical Details:

Stack:
React Native, MongoDB, AWS.

Data:
I built a custom aggregator that scrapes and normalizes lineup data from various sources to handle the 'entity resolution' problem (e.g., ensuring 'Artist A' is the same person across different posters).

Privacy:
All music library analysis is performed locally on-device where possible.
I'd love to hear your thoughts on the UI or any technical questions about the matching logic. I’m also looking for feedback on how to improve the schedule-sharing feature for groups!

How do you find concerts/music festivals that match your taste? How many festivals you join per year?

Cheers!

Hi HN,

I built this app because I found it surprisingly hard to answer a simple question:
which music festivals feature artists I actually want to see?

The app lets you:
– discover music festivals by artist
– view full lineups in one place
– save festivals you’re interested in

It’s a mobile app, built as a side project.

Tech stack: React Native / Expo, custom data aggregation.

I’d really appreciate feedback — especially from people who attend music festivals or have thoughts on what would make this more useful.

Link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/festiveo/id6755355854

Hi HN,

I’m Kirill, a developer, and I’ve been building Festiveo, an app for music festival lovers. It helps you discover festivals worldwide, track lineups, get updates, and plan your festival calendar.

Some things you can do with Festiveo:

Browse festivals by country, genre, or date.

See full lineups and artist info.

Save festivals to your personal list.

Get early alerts about lineup rumors and updates.

I built this app because I love going to festivals and wanted an easier way to keep everything organized in one place.

I’d love to hear your feedback on the app, what features you’d like, and what could make it more useful for festival-goers.
